name: Chole Island
tagline: Chole Island is a small, peaceful island located in the Mafia Archipelago off the southern coast of Tanzania
intro: Chole Island is a small, peaceful island located in the Mafia Archipelago off the southern coast of Tanzania. Known for its rich Swahili history, untouched marine environment, and relaxed island lifestyle, it is one of the most authentic and less-crowded destinations in the Indian Ocean. Unlike busier islands such as Zanzibar, it offers a raw and intimate experience, making it perfect for travelers seeking nature, culture, and tranquility.

It lies just a short boat ride from Mafia Island and is part of the Mafia Island Marine Park. Surrounded by mangroves, coral reefs, and turquoise waters, the island is easily accessible via Mafia Island, which can be reached by domestic flights from Dar es Salaam.

The island has a fascinating history dating back to the 18th and 19th centuries when it was an important trading center for merchants dealing in coconuts, copra, and spices. Today, remnants of old Swahili ruins, ancient mosques, and colonial buildings can still be seen scattered across the island. The local community maintains strong Swahili traditions, offering visitors a genuine cultural experience.
